sourceDesignRules.source: allwinner-h3.kicad_pro global minimum and DDR3_Signal net class

metadata.viaInPadPolicy: Assumed disabled; no permission inferred from source
metadata.blindBuriedPolicy: Disabled in H3/BB-AI project; A64 assumption consistent with all source DDR through vias
assumptions: All pre-existing copper tracks, vias and zones removed; all board pad obstacles retained.
Rectangular/oval/custom pads conservatively represented as bounding rectangles.
Board routing bounds are Edge.Cuts bounding box; internal cutouts not encoded.
All native copper layers available to router, including source power/ground planes; source plane reservations not encoded.
No impedance, reference-plane continuity, electrical-delay, or manufacturer timing requirements inferred.
